subject: How to completely silence stan in R

messages.author: 82a5c9fe6cf0d2bb
messages.subject: How to completely silence stan in R
parts:
Hi all, I am new to stan. I was trying to run stan function in a loop and the function will be called a vast amount of times. Hence I want to completely silence the stan terminal outputs. I only found this post in which stan(...,refresh=-1) is suggested. I tried but the stan function still outputs the "Elapsed Time" info. I wonder if there is a way to completely silence Rstan.

Thanks!

I think you have to wrap it inside a capture.output() statement.

Ben

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: How to completely silence stan in R
parts:
Give this a try:

txt <- capture.output(fit <- stan(...))

Now txt should have all the sampler output and fit is your stanfit object. Let me know if that doesn't work.

Jonah
